rungs.title: Free-space motion
rungs.description: Three minimum-jerk tool moves through free space, 0.8 s each with 0.3 s rests. Tests plain tracking with the feed-forward the trajectory carries.

gates.why: tracks a slow free-space path within a degree
the motion fits the boards' torque (at the cap < 2 % of the time)
nothing went non-finite or out of bounds
no board fault and no controller abort
the host kept its rate: no period went by without a command
a command goes out within one host period (10 ms) of the sample it came from

rungs.title: Fast free-space motion
rungs.description: The same tool path at 0.3 s per move, near the boards' torque limits. Tests tracking when inertia, not gravity, dominates.

gates.why: tracks a fast free-space path within 3 degrees
the fast motion stays mostly inside the boards' torque

the host kept its rate: no period went by without a command

rungs.title: Sideways push
rungs.description: The arm holds home while a 15 N push along +x acts on the tool for 0.4 s. Tests stiffness under a disturbance and how fast and cleanly it recovers.

rungs.title: Rapid replanning
rungs.description: A new 0.6 s trajectory every 0.15 s, eight times, each from the previous one's state at that instant to rest at a seeded target within 20 degrees of home. Tests taking a new plan mid-motion without a jump.

rungs.title: Host stall
rungs.description: R1's path with 0.3 ms of wake jitter and one 0.5 s host stall at t = 0.8 s (the F09 hang); the boards' watchdog brakes the arm. Tests that the controller comes back on schedule.

gates.why: nothing went non-finite or out of bounds

settles within 1 s after the reference ends

controllers.name: joint_trajectory_controller
controllers.title: Joint trajectory controller
controllers.summary: Samples the trajectory at the time since it started and streams position, velocity and feed-forward to the board's own PD; a late tick skips ahead, so it stays on schedule.

controllers.name: tape_feeder
controllers.title: Tape feeder
controllers.summary: Sends the trajectory's next sample every tick, whatever the clock says (bam_controllers v1); a late tick slips the rest of the trajectory and it refuses a new trajectory while running.

controllers.name: joint_impedance_board
controllers.title: Joint impedance on the board
controllers.summary: Renders a joint spring and damper on the servo board: sends stiffness and damping with every setpoint, so the board's fast PD closes the impedance (moteus kp_scale / kd_scale).

controllers.name: joint_impedance_host
controllers.title: Joint impedance on the host
controllers.summary: Computes the same spring and damper on the host as a torque, with the board's gains at zero; the law closes at the host rate, behind the bus delay.

controllers.name: joint_impedance_host_spring
controllers.title: Host spring, board damper
controllers.summary: Puts the spring on the host as a torque and the damper on the board (kp 0, kd > 0), so damping acts at board rate while the host shapes stiffness.
